summary: The source-side estimate correctly contradicts the case rho_E = 2, but the proof does not establish rho_E >= 3 because it never excludes affine ranks 0 and 1.
critical_errors: The claimed equivalence between rho_E >= 3 and rho_E != 2 is unjustified without an independent lower bound rho_E >= 2. Accepted fact 7ec63df101c30343 supplies positive total I-triangle mass and makes each individual source triple noncollinear, but it does not state or imply that the support of the opposite-edge midpoints is not contained in an affine line.
gaps: The final sentence asserts that the positive target mass lies outside every affine line, but no supplied predecessor fact or preceding argument proves this. Positive opposite-edge triangle mass only makes E nonempty; the midpoints m_e could, on the stated evidence, all coincide or all lie on one affine line.
repair_hints: Start the contradiction from rho_E <= 2 and repeat the same slice argument. Then P = aff(E) and every P_u = 2P-u have affine dimension at most 2, so the support-free bound from fact 8aac56c49321466c still applies, including ranks 0 and 1; this would exclude all rho_E <= 2 without the unsupported target-spanning assertion.
